name: Royal Palaces of Abomey
description: In the town of Abomey in southern Benin, earthen-walled palaces mark the heart of the former Kingdom of Dahomey. Twelve kings ruled here between 1625 and 1900, and at its peak the complex could house up to 8,000 people. Today the palaces of Ghézo and Glélé hold a museum telling the kingdom's story.
